name: Edith Stein
shortBio: German phenomenologist and Edmund Husserl's assistant who authored On the Problem of Empathy, pioneering phenomenological psychology of intersubjectivity before synthesizing Husserl with Thomistic metaphysics.
centralQuestion: How is the immediate, non-inferential experience of another person's conscious feelings possible through embodied empathy (Einfühlung)?

keyWorks.title: On the Problem of Empathy
keyWorks.description: Doctoral dissertation supervised by Husserl defining empathy as a primordial, non-projective experience of foreign consciousness.

keyWorks.title: Finite and Eternal Being
keyWorks.description: Posthumously published synthesis uniting Husserlian phenomenology with Aquinas's ontology of essence and existence.
